metric_interpretation: One effective canonical-proposition universe, not a raw-generated-class confusion matrix. An FP=0 here means no affirmative unsupported generated-only proposition was established by the Phase 4 bounded search; it is not certification of perfect precision. Phase 5 must challenge all weak/generated-only provisional support and positive-source proof.
limitations: The 6,865-class validity ledger is a bounded automated/manual-rule best-effort adjudication, not an independently verified predicate-by-predicate proof for every class.
3904 classes have weak PDF lexical corroboration and require affirmative PDF-entailment verification; these may change the provisional FP count in Phase 5.
9 explicitly unadopted proposal cells were extracted as raw classes in the earlier phase; they are excluded as affirmative predictions pending duplicate/eligibility corrections in Phase 5.
No new PDF-positive source atoms were added in Phase 4. The source inventory and source TP/FN decisions are inherited from the completed Phase 3.
The fixed negative-control set is bounded. Its TN count does not represent every possible unsupported requirement.
Duplicate metrics are reserved for Phase 5; raw class and occurrence counts are displayed only for audit.
